problem_type: Model-list summary recomputes credential readiness as executable usability
symptom: Summary says 21 usable models while only 16 returned rows say usable=true.
direct_cause: buildListModelsOutcome counts keyStatus=ok rather than the canonical per-row usable result.
class_root: The outward summary re-derives an authoritative catalog fact from a weaker credential field.
internal_only_reason: Internal projection defect; the existing shared modelPublication.rowServesMode contract already defines the answer.
invariants: Summary usable count equals the count of rows with usable===true.
Credential readiness alone cannot make an unusable or unevidenced row selectable.
Structured model rows are preserved unchanged.

door_reduction.why_not: Distinct existing UI/result consumers remain; the owner projection and its private helper are included by generated door scans.

generality_proof: Both localized text and structured count derive from the same authoritative usable partition, covering every provider and reason without provider branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Summarize canonical model row facts without deriving usability from credentials.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both text and structured output are created by this projection.
Generated door map confirms native result payloads consume the outcome builder.

recurrence.reason: Any credential-ready provider can remain blocked by another authoritative availability reason.
same_class_scan: Compared createCatalogAvailability and model-list thin-row usable evidence
Checked mcpResultPayload consumer and both localized text branches
Refreshed generated door map after whole-owner extraction: buildToolOutcome, buildListModelsOutcome, acceptsTag

prevention.invariant: Only authoritative usable===true rows count as usable.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing usability is not inferred; blocked rows and their reasons stay visible.
prevention.strategy: Replace keyStatus partitions and success markers with the returned usable fact.

legacy_paths.rationale: The weaker key-only summary predicate is removed, not retained as a compatibility fallback.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade; reuse existing shared publication contract.

migration: No catalog/settings migration and no endpoint probes are introduced.
residual_risks: Catalog usability is not a claim that an inference request or live endpoint probe has succeeded.
